description: This file contains internal utility functions, test configurations, environment flags, and test orchestration code for the PyTorch testing framework. It defines mechanisms for test parametrization, environment variable management, test execution control, and platform-specific utilities.

classes.name: ProfilingMode
classes.description: Enumeration representing different profiling modes for PyTorch JIT graph execution.

classes.name: TestEnvironment
classes.description: Class providing static methods to define and manage test environment flags and settings.

classes.name: TrackedInput
classes.description: Data class for storing tracked test input data for debugging.

classes.name: TrackedInputIter
classes.description: Iterator wrapper that tracks the most recent value produced for debugging purposes.

classes.name: _TestParametrizer
classes.description: Base class for test parametrization decorators.

classes.name: subtest
classes.description: Class for explicit subtest configuration with custom name and decorators.

classes.name: parametrize
classes.description: Decorator class for parameterizing test functions with various input combinations.

classes.name: reparametrize
classes.description: Decorator class for modifying existing parametrizations with an adapter function.

classes.name: decorateIf
classes.description: Decorator that conditionally applies other decorators based on test parameters.

classes.name: CrossRefMode
classes.description: Custom torch.overrides.TorchFunctionMode for cross-referencing computations in tests.

classes.name: TestGradients
classes.description: Test class providing gradient checking utilities and helpers, derived from unittest.TestCase.

classes.name: NestedTensorTestCase
classes.description: Test case class with helpers for nested tensor behaviors.

methods.name: is_navi3_arch
methods.description: Checks if the current CUDA device has a Navi3 architecture based on device properties.

methods.name: freeze_rng_state
methods.description: Utility function for freezing random number generator state in tests.

methods.name: gcIfJetson
methods.description: Decorator that performs garbage collection and clears CUDA cache on Jetson devices.

methods.name: extract_test_fn
methods.description: Extracts the current test function from the call stack for debugging purposes.

methods.name: get_tracked_input
methods.description: Retrieves the current tracked input from the test function context.

methods.name: clear_tracked_input
methods.description: Clears the tracked input in the current test function context.

methods.name: get_tracked_input
methods.description: Retrieves the tracked input for debugging from the current test context.

methods.name: TrackedInputIter
methods.description: Class wrapping an iterator for tracking last produced value.

methods.name: compose_parametrize_fns
methods.description: Function to compose two parametrization functions into one, yielding the product of parameters.

methods.name: instantiate_parametrized_tests
methods.description: Function to instantiate tests decorated with parametrization decorators into actual test methods.

methods.name: reparametrize
methods.description: Decorator class for adjusting existing parametrizations with a custom adapter function.

methods.name: enable_profiling_mode_for_profiling_tests
methods.description: Context manager to enable profiling mode for profiling tests.

methods.name: enable_profiling_mode
methods.description: Context manager to enable profiling mode globally.

methods.name: num_profiled_runs
methods.description: Context manager to set the number of profiling runs.

methods.name: prof_callable
methods.description: Wrapper function to profile the execution of callables.

methods.name: raise_on_run_directly
methods.description: Raises a RuntimeError if a test file is run directly, guiding proper invocation.

methods.name: prof_func_call
methods.description: Profiles a ScriptFunction call.

methods.name: prof_meth_call
methods.description: Profiles a ScriptMethod call.

methods.name: get_test_report_path
methods.description: Determines the filesystem path for storing test reports.

methods.name: parse_cmd_line_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to test execution configuration.

methods.name: wait_for_process
methods.description: Waits for a subprocess to complete, with support for timeout and signal handling.

methods.name: shell
methods.description: Executes a command in a subprocess with standardized handling.

methods.name: retry_shell
methods.description: Retries a shell command upon failure with specified retries.

methods.name: discover_test_cases_recursively
methods.description: Recursively discovers all test cases within a suite or test case.

methods.name: get_test_names
methods.description: Extracts the test names from test case objects.

methods.name: sanitize_test_filename
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename into a dotted test module style.

methods.name: lint_test_case_extension
methods.description: Checks that all test classes extend from unittest.TestCase.

methods.name: get_report_path
methods.description: Constructs the filesystem path for test reports, optionally with pytest integration.

methods.name: sanitize_pytest_xml
methods.description: Modifies pytest XML output to match unittest format.

methods.name: get_pytest_test_cases
methods.description: Uses pytest to collect test case identifiers.

methods.name: run_tests
methods.description: Main orchestrator for executing tests with various modes (subprocess, parallel, pytest, XML reports, etc.).

methods.name: is_avx512_vnni_supported
methods.description: Detects if the CPU supports AVX512 VNNI via /proc/cpuinfo (Linux only).

methods.name: skipIfCrossRef
methods.description: Decorator that skips tests if cross-reference mode is active.
